page.overview:
What is Ball Breaker?

The Stand is a visualization of Spin energy produced by the user's steel balls, It supposedly can be accessed by all users of the Spin, this being due to the requirments it takes to summon it.

Ball Breaker is relatively small, roughly the size of the Steel Ball it originates from. It's vaguely humanoid in shape; hunched, with paw- or -like feet, with several "eyes" punched in a random formation on its face. Its body is studded in a similar way, with large, comma-shaped appendages on either side of its head, most likely meant to resemble the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Golden_spiral golden spiral] . Ball Breaker is usually surrounded by a cloud of energy reminiscent of electrostatic discharge.

Ball Breaker is primarily green, with pink features in all (current) media featuring it.

Little is known about Ball Breaker's full capabilities as it only has one appearance and the technique was flawed due to an imperfect Steel Ball. It can be assumed that, since it is developed from the Golden Spin, Ball Breaker is incredibly powerful.
